method.target: next exact NY17 log return / sign
method.fast_midas_basis: 60 completed/current-origin daily lags compressed by fixed degree-2 Almon basis
method.slow_midas_basis: 12 completed monthly lags compressed by fixed degree-2 Almon basis
method.slow_inputs: Gold/Silver/Platinum/Palladium monthly returns + PIT GPR vintage lagged strictly
models: independent material-UP and material-DOWN logistic heads
method.tail_definition: origin-safe rolling 67th percentile of absolute one-day return; material heads are non-complementary
